description: Μελέτες Προμηθειών & Υπηρεσιών Οργανισμού Προσχολικής Αγωγής και Κοινωνικής Μέριμνας is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Μαμουδέλης Θεόδωρος. Studji dwar l-Akkwist u s-Servizzi tal-Organizzazzjoni tal-Edukazzjoni Preprimarja u l-Kura Soċjali tal-Muniċipalità ta’ Lixandra għas-snin 2015 sa 2019. Coverage: Μαμουδέλης Θεόδωρος. The portal shows the English title as "A Koragyermekkori Nevelés és Szociális Ellátás Szervezetének beszerzési és szolgáltatási tanulmányai" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Μαμουδέλης Θεόδωρος. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Υπηρεσία, Από μετάπτωση, Προμήθεια, Μελέτη. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
